what: Proposed quiet-log staging keeps the missing breadcrumbs source early return
scenario_or_breakage: When a session has root-level larch-quiet-*-*.log files but no breadcrumbs/ directory, commit returns before checking quiet logs, so the new forensic artifact is silently skipped
suggested_fix: Compute session_root first and let missing/empty breadcrumbs only skip the ndjson loop; return only after both ndjson and root quiet-log scans find nothing

what: Inline /design publish callsites are not updated for the new non-zero post-push contract
scenario_or_breakage: A post-push design-log-publish failure can exit 1 before prompt-side orchestration parses PUBLISH_OK=false, preventing the documented warning/log preservation and rename skip flow
suggested_fix: Revise both publish instructions to capture stdout, stderr, and rc under set +e semantics, then parse PUBLISH_OK regardless of rc, matching design-pause-save.sh
